title: Kanna'im Target Gedolei Yisroel
body: Kanna'im launched a robo-call campaign targeting Slabodka roshei yeshiva Rav Dov Landau and Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch, maligning them in a bizayon haTorah attack timed with Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch's arrival.

title: Bismuth Leads Draft Law Hearing
body: Knesset Committee Chairman MK Boaz Bismuth opened the first formal discussion of a new draft law, emphasizing both security needs and the spiritual significance of Torah study.
